what: A strip of picture·caption cells laid out horizontally — the first cell starts aligned to the left edge of the center column and continues off the right edge of the screen. On phones it follows finger scroll as is, with a mouse it follows the hand when grabbed and dragged, and on release it glides by inertia (shrinks by .72 per frame and follows by .12) and snaps to the center of the nearest cell. Wheel and left·right keys also snap cell by cell, and link presses are blocked while dragging — exactly as blossom-carousel 0.2.0 embedded in the original site
ease: blossom-carousel physics (inertia .72 · follow .12) then native scroll-snap

options.repeat: With true, both ends join and it loops endlessly (library repeat)
options.--fx-col: Cell width (css), default min(100%, 42.25rem) — the original is a 6/12 column
options.--fx-gap: Gap between cells (css), default 1.5rem — original phone .375rem
options.--fx-pad: Band inner padding at both ends (css), default fits the center column
options.--fx-align: Where the cell attaches (css), default center

note: Include the library css (../_vendor/blossom-carousel-core@0.2.0/blossom-carousel-core.css) and js together. If the panel wrapping the strip has container-type: inline-size and overflow: hidden, it does not spill off-screen as in the original
